entries: **Report charts now state their conclusion.** Each section title says what the data shows, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and source line under the chart. Tools, projects and cache hit rate become thin bars on a 0-100% axis, token composition is one stacked bar, and the weekly list becomes a column chart that marks the busiest and latest complete weeks.

**The report opens faster on heavy history.** The usage-habits section keeps its profile for an hour instead of five minutes, so most report opens skip rescanning every session file. Usage numbers and charts stay live.
**The menu bar shows the Antigravity recovery countdown again.** When quota is used up, it shows the time left until recovery and keeps refreshing at the short polling interval.

**Auto-open the next Claude window works again.** Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stops reporting the 5-hour window once it expires, so the keeper never saw it expire and never opened the next one. It now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window after it passes. Plans without a 5-hour limit are unaffected.

**Reset Claude quota rows and recovery notifications work again.** Since 0.34.10, the 5-hour and weekly rows showed `--` after a reset, and quota-restored notifications waited until the next Claude reply. The hook now keeps each expired window for one full cycle so readers show 0% and the reset message, and recovery notifications arrive at reset. Plans without a 5-hour limit still drop that window after a full cycle; weekly updates keep working.

title.zh-TW: 報表圖表直接標記結論，改用直覺長條與每週趨勢圖
title.en: Report charts directly state conclusions, switching to intuitive bars and weekly trend charts

body.zh-TW: 當你打開用量報表想快速掌握整體的呼叫狀況時，不再需要對著複雜圖表逐項心算。⟦有如收到整頓後的健檢摘要，以前整頁只印滿密密麻麻的化驗數字，得逐項翻找對照標準；現在每區頂端直接印出重點結論，各項指標也縮成清楚的進度條。⟧現在報表每一區的標題會直接寫出結論，例如「Claude Code 以 66% 的 token 領先」，圖下並附上副標題與資料來源。這裡的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成現在改成一條堆疊長條。工具、專案與快取（將運算結果暫存供後續取用）命中率，則全數換成 0 到 100% 刻度的細長條。每週清單也改成直條圖，並替你標出最忙碌與最近一個完整週。
body.en: When you open the usage report to quickly grasp your overall call activity, you no longer need to perform mental calculations item by item over complex charts. ⟦Picture receiving a reorganized health checkup summary: where full pages were once packed with dense lab numbers requiring line-by-line checks against reference standards, key conclusions are now printed right at the top of each section, with individual metrics condensed into clear progress bars.⟧ Section titles across each area of the report now state their conclusion directly, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and data source line beneath the chart. Here, token (the text units AI processes and bills) composition has been changed into a single stacked bar. Tools, projects, and cache hit rates have all been switched to thin bars on a 0 to 100% scale. The weekly list is also turned into a column chart, marking the busiest and latest complete weeks for you.

items.original: **Report charts now state their conclusion.** Each section title says what the data shows, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and source line under the chart. Tools, projects and cache hit rate become thin bars on a 0-100% axis, token composition is one stacked bar, and the weekly list becomes a column chart that marks the busiest and latest complete weeks.

title.zh-TW: 使用習慣分析保留一小時，累積大量紀錄開報表不卡頓
title.en: Usage habit analysis is kept for an hour, opening reports without jank on heavy history

body.zh-TW: 累積了大量歷史紀錄的使用者，以往每次開啟用量報表往往需要耗費時間等待重新載入。⟦跟常客走進熟識的咖啡館一樣，櫃檯直接調出你常點的喜好清單，不必每次重新翻閱歷來點單；至於收銀機上的當日銷額與即時牌價，則隨時都在同步刷新。⟧現在使用習慣區的分析結果改為保留一小時，不再像過去每五分鐘就必須重新計算。這讓多數開啟報表的時刻，可以直接略過重新掃描所有工作階段（session，單次交談歷程）檔案的流程。所有用量數據與圖表依然維持即時更新，不會因為分析結果保留而延遲呈現。
body.en: For users who have accumulated heavy historical records, opening the usage report in the past often required spending time waiting for reloads. ⟦Just like a regular customer walking into a familiar cafe, the counter brings up your frequent preferences directly without flipping through past orders each time; meanwhile, daily sales and real-time prices on the cash register stay synchronized and refreshed at all times.⟧ Analysis results in the usage habits section are now retained for an hour instead of being recalculated every five minutes as in the past. This allows most report opens to directly skip the process of rescanning all session (a single conversation history) files. All usage numbers and charts continue to update in real time without being delayed by retaining the analysis results.

items.original: **The report opens faster on heavy history.** The usage-habits section keeps its profile for an hour instead of five minutes, so most report opens skip rescanning every session file. Usage numbers and charts stay live.

title.zh-TW: 修復額度恢復倒數、重置顯示與 Claude 視窗排程
title.en: Fix quota recovery countdowns, reset displays, and Claude window scheduling

body.zh-TW:
仰賴用量工具掌握模型配額的讀者，在額度耗盡或重置時能重新獲得即時狀態。

選單列已恢復顯示 Antigravity 額度的恢復倒數。當額度用完時會顯示距離恢復的剩餘時間，並維持短間隔更新頻率。

自 0.34.10 起，Claude Code 在 5 小時視窗過期後便不再回報，導致自動啟動無法偵測過期而停擺。現在工具會記住上次看到的重置時間，時間一過就照常開啟下一個視窗；沒有 5 小時額度的方案不受影響。

同樣從 0.34.10 起出現的顯示問題，也讓 5 小時與每週列在重置後顯示 `--`，額度恢復通知更被延至下一則回覆才發出。現在 hook（特定事件發生時自動觸發的小程式）會多保留過期視窗一整個週期，讓讀取端照常顯示 0% 與已重置，並在重置時立即送出恢復通知。沒有 5 小時額度的方案在超過一整個週期後仍會移除視窗，每週額度則持續更新。
body.en:
Readers who rely on usage tools to track model quotas can now regain real-time status when quotas are exhausted or reset.

The menu bar has restored displaying the Antigravity quota recovery countdown. When quota is used up, it shows the remaining time until recovery and maintains a short update interval.

Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stopped reporting the 5-hour window once it expired, causing auto-open to fail to detect the expiration and stall. The tool now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window as usual once that time passes; plans without a 5-hour quota are unaffected.

A display issue that also appeared since 0.34.10 caused the 5-hour and weekly rows to show `--` after a reset, while quota recovery notifications were delayed until the next reply was sent. Now the hook (a small program automatically triggered by specific events) retains expired windows for one full cycle, allowing readers to display 0% and reset status as usual, and immediately sends recovery notifications upon reset. Plans without a 5-hour quota still remove the window after more than a full cycle, while weekly quotas continue to update.

items.original:
**The menu bar shows the Antigravity recovery countdown again.** When quota is used up, it shows the time left until recovery and keeps refreshing at the short polling interval.
**Auto-open the next Claude window works again.** Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stops reporting the 5-hour window once it expires, so the keeper never saw it expire and never opened the next one. It now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window after it passes. Plans without a 5-hour limit are unaffected.
**Reset Claude quota rows and recovery notifications work again.** Since 0.34.10, the 5-hour and weekly rows showed `--` after a reset, and quota-restored notifications waited until the next Claude reply. The hook now keeps each expired window for one full cycle so readers show 0% and the reset message, and recovery notifications arrive at reset. Plans without a 5-hour limit still drop that window after a full cycle; weekly updates keep working.

entries: **A used-up quota now shows how long until it comes back.** When a tool's 5-hour or weekly quota reaches 100%, the menu bar shows the time left, such as `2h55m`, instead of a stuck `100%`. If both are used up, it counts down to the later reset; if the reset time is unknown, it keeps showing `100%`. While a countdown is shown, the menu bar refreshes every minute instead of every five. The Claude Code status line does the same in red and keeps the time left even in a narrow terminal.

**The status line no longer freezes quota on plans without a 5-hour limit.** Since Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) get only the weekly window. The status line treated that as missing data and kept showing the last full snapshot, so the weekly bar stopped moving and an expired 5-hour bar stayed on screen. Each window now updates on its own; a window Claude Code stops sending disappears once its reset time has passed. The menu bar reads a weekly-only status the same way instead of waiting for both windows. Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

title.zh-TW: 選單列與狀態列在額度用完時改倒數剩餘時間
title.en: The Menu Bar and Status Line Count Down the Time Left When a Quota Is Used Up

body.zh-TW: 當你密集請 AI 寫程式或查資料時，常需要隨時掌握用量上限。⟦跟在熱門停車場入口看車位動態一樣，以前車位全滿時看板只會卡在客滿紅字，現在直接換成離場倒數計時，每分鐘跳一次，即便只剩單行小螢幕也能看清剩餘時間。⟧現在選單列與 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）正是如此運作：某個工具的 5 小時或每週額度達到 100% 時，不再卡在 `100%`，而是改顯示剩餘時間，例如 `2h55m`。兩種額度都用完時會倒數到比較晚恢復的那一個，不知道重置時間時則維持顯示 `100%`。在倒數期間，選單列會加快為每分鐘更新一次，不用等五分鐘。Claude Code 狀態列也同步改以紅字顯示倒數，終端機視窗再窄也會完整留著這段剩餘時間。
body.en: When you rely heavily on AI to write code or look up information, you often need to keep track of your usage limits at all times. ⟦Picture checking parking spot availability at the entrance of a popular parking lot: previously when the lot was full, the sign stayed stuck on a red "Full" notice, but now it directly switches to a departure countdown that ticks every minute, letting you clearly see the time left even on a single-line small display.⟧ That is now how the menu bar and the status line (the bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) work: when a tool's 5-hour or weekly quota reaches 100%, instead of staying stuck at `100%`, it now shows the time left, such as `2h55m`. When both quotas are used up, it counts down to whichever one resets later, and if the reset time is unknown, it keeps showing `100%`. During the countdown, the menu bar speeds up to refresh once every minute instead of waiting five minutes. The Claude Code status line also synchronously displays the countdown in red, keeping this time left intact even when the terminal window is narrow.

items.original: **A used-up quota now shows how long until it comes back.** When a tool's 5-hour or weekly quota reaches 100%, the menu bar shows the time left, such as `2h55m`, instead of a stuck `100%`. If both are used up, it counts down to the later reset; if the reset time is unknown, it keeps showing `100%`. While a countdown is shown, the menu bar refreshes every minute instead of every five. The Claude Code status line does the same in red and keeps the time left even in a narrow terminal.

title.zh-TW: 無 5 小時額度方案不再卡死狀態列與選單列
title.en: Plans Without a 5-Hour Limit No Longer Freeze the Status Line and Menu Bar

body.zh-TW: 若你使用的是沒有 5 小時額度限制的帳號方案，最近可能遇過用量數據完全凍結不動的狀況。從 Claude Code 2.1.316 開始，沒有 5 小時額度的帳號（例如 Ultra 方案）只會收到每週額度數據。過去 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）會把這種單一額度當成資料不全，導致畫面一直卡在最後一次的完整紀錄：每週額度條停止跳動，過期的 5 小時額度條也遲遲不退場。現在各個額度窗口改為各自獨立更新，Claude Code 不再送來的額度只要過了重置時間便會自動隱藏。選單列也同步支援單一額度讀取，不用再苦等兩個額度都到齊。⟦雙欄計分板在更新賽況時，以前若少了一組比賽成績，整面看板就會卡在上一輪的舊紀錄；現在每組各自刷新，不再開打的場次過期後便自動撤下。⟧感謝 @dvdmaru 回報問題並提交修復（#273）。
body.en: If you use an account plan with no 5-hour limit, you might have recently experienced usage data freezing completely. Starting in Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) receive only weekly quota data. Previously, the status line (the bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) treated this single quota as incomplete data, causing the screen to remain stuck on the last complete snapshot: the weekly bar stopped moving, and the expired 5-hour bar lingered without disappearing. Now, each quota window updates independently, and any quota that Claude Code stops sending will automatically disappear once its reset time has passed. The menu bar also synchronously supports reading a single quota, without having to wait for both quotas to arrive. ⟦Much like a two-column scoreboard updating match results, if one score was missing in the past, the entire board remained stuck on the previous round's old record; now each section refreshes independently, and matches no longer being played are automatically removed once they expire.⟧ Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

items.original: **The status line no longer freezes quota on plans without a 5-hour limit.** Since Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) get only the weekly window. The status line treated that as missing data and kept showing the last full snapshot, so the weekly bar stopped moving and an expired 5-hour bar stayed on screen. Each window now updates on its own; a window Claude Code stops sending disappears once its reset time has passed. The menu bar reads a weekly-only status the same way instead of waiting for both windows. Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

entries: **Downloaded macOS apps now pass signature verification.** The release zip stored copies in place of the symlinks inside the bundled Python framework, so every download through v0.34.8, Homebrew installs included, failed `codesign --verify` with "bundle format is ambiguous", and any later tampering could not be told apart. Releases are now zipped with `ditto`, which keeps the symlinks, and the release job verifies the zipped app's signature before publishing. The download is about 9 MB smaller.

title.zh-TW: macOS 下載版通過系統簽章驗證，安裝包體積縮小 9 MB
title.en: Downloaded macOS apps pass signature verification, and installer size shrinks by 9 MB

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上手動下載應用程式或透過 Homebrew 安裝時，現在能放心地替安裝檔查驗身分。在 v0.34.8 與更早的版本中，釋出的 zip 壓縮檔把內建 Python 框架裡的符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），直接存成了檔案複本。這導致執行 `codesign --verify` 驗證簽章時，都會回傳套件格式不明確（bundle format is ambiguous）的錯誤訊息而失敗，事後若遭竄改也無從分辨。現在發布流程改用 `ditto` 工具壓縮並保留捷徑，發布前也會驗證簽章，下載檔案體積也縮小了約 9 MB。⟦就像翻閱附有索引的旅遊指南，以前若把指針標記印成整份重複地圖，查核印鑑時會因版面混亂而無法辨識真偽；現在維持清楚的指標參照，驗章順利過關，整本手冊也輕盈不少。⟧
body.en: When manually downloading the app on a Mac or installing it through Homebrew, you can now confidently verify the installer's identity. In v0.34.8 and earlier versions, released zip archives stored file copies instead of symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) inside the bundled Python framework. Because of this, running `codesign --verify` to check signatures always failed with the error message "bundle format is ambiguous", leaving any later tampering undetectable. The release process now compresses archives using the `ditto` tool to preserve shortcuts, also verifies signatures before publishing, and reduces download size by about 9 MB. ⟦Picture flipping through an indexed travel guide: previously, printing pointer markers as entire duplicate maps made it impossible to tell genuine stamps from fake ones due to layout confusion; now, maintaining clear pointer references lets seal verification pass smoothly, and the entire handbook is noticeably lighter.⟧

items.original: **Downloaded macOS apps now pass signature verification.** The release zip stored copies in place of the symlinks inside the bundled Python framework, so every download through v0.34.8, Homebrew installs included, failed `codesign --verify` with "bundle format is ambiguous", and any later tampering could not be told apart. Releases are now zipped with `ditto`, which keeps the symlinks, and the release job verifies the zipped app's signature before publishing. The download is about 9 MB smaller.

entries: **A masked report no longer leaks project names.** When you hid project names and downloaded the HTML report, each project row still carried its real name in a hidden accessibility label, readable by anyone who opened the file's source. Masking now also covers those labels, tooltips and image descriptions.

**Names in an exported CSV no longer run as spreadsheet formulas.** A project or model name starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` was written as-is, so Excel could treat it as a formula. Such names now start with an apostrophe and stay plain text.

**A downloaded project can no longer use its Git settings to run a program through Progress Concierge.** Progress Concierge runs `git status` in your project when a session starts, and a repository's own `.git/config` can tell Git to launch a file-system monitor program. usage now switches that monitor off for its check.

**The macOS app keeps a valid code signature after it runs.** Python wrote its compiled caches into the app on first launch, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to tell apart. The caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside the app changes while it runs. The app is about 2 MB larger.

**Releases are built only from locked, hash-verified build tools.** The PyPI package is built in a step that cannot publish, from a pinned build backend, and the Windows build pins PyInstaller the same way. October's supply-chain attacks published poisoned packages through hijacked release pipelines; this closes that path here. The setuptools used to build the macOS app is also updated to 84.2.1 for GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

**Turning on Token Saver no longer breaks some Codex configs.** If `~/.codex/config.toml` wrote the features setting as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, usage added a second `[features]` section and Codex then refused to load the file. usage now checks the edited file first and leaves it untouched if the edit would not parse.

**GPT-6.1 Terra is priced while offline.** Codex's new GPT-6.1 Terra model counted as $0 whenever the price table could not be downloaded. The built-in fallback now carries its price, $1 / $5 per million input / output tokens.

**Panel titles no longer cut off the bottoms of g and y.** In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" lost the tails of their descenders, because the box that trims long titles was shorter than the letters. The box now has room for them; the layout does not move.
**The app no longer bundles the retired AI Council window.** Its page was left behind when the feature was removed in v0.30.11, and nothing loaded it.

title.zh-TW: 匯出報表徹底遮蓋專案名稱，CSV 檔案防止符號觸發試算表公式
title.en: Exported reports thoroughly mask project names, and CSV files prevent symbols from triggering spreadsheet formulas

body.zh-TW: 需要把專案用量匯出給外部團隊或主管審閱時，檔案本身的隱私與安全性現在有了更周全的防護。以往隱藏專案名稱並下載 HTML 報表，每一列資料其實還把真名藏在給輔助工具讀取的標籤裡，打開檔案原始碼就看得到。現在遮罩連同這些標籤、滑鼠提示與圖片說明一起蓋掉。若是匯出 CSV 檔案，專案名或模型名以 `=`、`+`、`-`、`@` 開頭時，舊版會原樣寫出，Excel 可能把它當成公式執行。現在這類名稱開頭會自動加上一個單引號，維持純文字呈現。⟦處理公文寄送時，以前若只用奇異筆塗黑紙面，背後的複寫痕跡仍會透光看見，特殊符號甚至會被自動掃描機誤當操作指令；現在底層複寫與附註會同步塗銷，開頭也加註標記維持純文字讀取。⟧
body.en: When you need to export project usage for external teams or managers to review, the privacy and security of the files themselves now have more comprehensive protection. Previously, when hiding project names and downloading an HTML report, each row of data actually still hid the real name inside a label read by assistive tools, visible to anyone opening the file's source code. Masking now covers those labels along with tooltips and image descriptions. If exporting a CSV file, when a project name or model name started with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@`, the older version wrote it as-is, so Excel could execute it as a formula. Such names now automatically start with a single quote to remain plain text. ⟦Think of dispatching official documents: in the past, blacking out paper with a marker still left carbon-copy traces visible against the light, and special symbols could even be mistaken for operational commands by automatic scanners; now underlying copies and notes are erased at the same time, with a prefix mark added to keep them read as plain text.⟧

items.original:
**A masked report no longer leaks project names.** When you hid project names and downloaded the HTML report, each project row still carried its real name in a hidden accessibility label, readable by anyone who opened the file's source. Masking now also covers those labels, tooltips and image descriptions.
**Names in an exported CSV no longer run as spreadsheet formulas.** A project or model name starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` was written as-is, so Excel could treat it as a formula. Such names now start with an apostrophe and stay plain text.

title.zh-TW: 進度管家在對話檢查時停用檔案監控，防止外部專案擅自執行程式
title.en: Progress Concierge disables file monitoring during session checks to prevent external projects from running programs without permission

body.zh-TW: 從網路下載開源專案來進行分析，最怕專案自帶的設定檔趁著背景檢查偷偷啟動惡意程式。⟦走進大樓櫃檯登記入內時，以前訪客繳交的證件若夾帶自動呼叫裝置，保全一翻開封面就會不知不覺觸發它運作；現在安檢只核對身分並切斷隨附的連動線路，杜絕未經許可的額外動作。⟧每當工作階段開始，進度管家會在專案目錄裡執行 `git status` 檢查目前狀態。然而專案自身的 `.git/config` 設定檔，原本可以指示 Git 同步啟動一支檔案監控程式，下載來的陌生專案便可能藉此暗中執行有害程式。現在 usage 執行這項檢查時會關閉檔案系統監控，防止下載的專案透過這項設定啟動程式。
body.en: When downloading open-source projects from the internet for analysis, the biggest worry is that bundled configuration files might sneakily launch malicious programs during background checks. ⟦Picture signing in at a building front desk: in the past, if a visitor's badge carried an automated pager, a security guard opening the cover would trigger it without knowing; now security checks only verify identity and cut off any accompanying trigger lines, stopping unauthorized actions entirely.⟧ Whenever a session begins, Progress Concierge runs `git status` in the project directory to check current status. However, a repository's own `.git/config` configuration file could originally instruct Git to launch a file-system monitor program at the same time, allowing an unfamiliar downloaded project to covertly execute harmful programs. usage now disables file-system monitoring when performing this check, preventing downloaded projects from launching programs through this setting.

items.original: **A downloaded project can no longer use its Git settings to run a program through Progress Concierge.** Progress Concierge runs `git status` in your project when a session starts, and a repository's own `.git/config` can tell Git to launch a file-system monitor program. usage now switches that monitor off for its check.

title.zh-TW: macOS 程式簽章執行後維持有效，發版流程鎖定建置工具防禦供應鏈攻擊
title.en: macOS code signatures remain valid after execution, and release pipelines lock build tools against supply-chain attacks

body.zh-TW: 在使用桌面應用程式或更新軟體時，程式本身的完整性有了明確把關。⟦檢驗精密儀器的出廠包裝時，以前開機運作就會破壞防偽封條，組裝工具遭竄改更可能混入瑕疵；現在封條在出廠前已妥善固化，產線也只採用驗證過規格的專用設備。⟧macOS app 第一次啟動時，以前 Python 會把編譯快取（把編譯結果暫存起來直接使用的檔案）寫進 app 裡，導致簽章失效且難以辨識竄改。現在快取在簽章前就先編好，執行時內部不再變動，簽章持續有效，app 大約多 2 MB。發布流程也防堵供應鏈攻擊。PyPI 套件改在無發布權限的步驟建置，工具版本鎖定並驗證雜湊；Windows 版的 PyInstaller 同樣鎖定，防範 10 月出現的劫持風險。打包 macOS app 用的 setuptools 亦升至 84.2.1，修補 GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w。
body.en: When using desktop applications or updating software, the integrity of the program itself now has clear safeguards. ⟦Inspecting factory packaging for precision instruments offers a comparison: previously, turning on the machine broke the tamper-evident seal, and altered assembly tools could introduce flaws; now seals are properly cured before shipping, and production lines use only dedicated equipment with verified specifications.⟧ On first launch of the macOS app, Python previously wrote its compiled caches into the app, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to identify. Caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside changes during execution, keeping the signature valid and making the app about 2 MB larger. The release workflow also defends against supply-chain attacks. The PyPI package is now built in a step without publishing permissions, with tool versions locked and hashes verified; the Windows version of PyInstaller is locked the same way to prevent hijacking risks that emerged in October. The setuptools used to package the macOS app is also upgraded to 84.2.1 to patch GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

items.original:
**The macOS app keeps a valid code signature after it runs.** Python wrote its compiled caches into the app on first launch, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to tell apart. The caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside the app changes while it runs. The app is about 2 MB larger.
**Releases are built only from locked, hash-verified build tools.** The PyPI package is built in a step that cannot publish, from a pinned build backend, and the Windows build pins PyInstaller the same way. October's supply-chain attacks published poisoned packages through hijacked release pipelines; this closes that path here. The setuptools used to build the macOS app is also updated to 84.2.1 for GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

title.zh-TW: 開啟省 token 模式不再損毀 Codex 設定檔，離線時為 GPT-6.1 Terra 補齊計價
title.en: Turning on Token Saver no longer corrupts Codex configs, and pricing is filled in for GPT-6.1 Terra while offline

body.zh-TW: 平時若習慣為 Codex 開啟省 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）模式，或常在離線環境工作，現在能更穩妥維護設定與統計開銷。若 `~/.codex/config.toml` 寫成 `features = { hooks = false }` 或 `features.hooks = false`，舊版多加 `[features]` 會讓 Codex 無法載入；現在會先檢查修改後的內容能否解析；若修改會讓檔案無法解析，就保留原檔。若價目表下載失敗，GPT-6.1 Terra 原本算為 $0；現在內建備援收錄價格，每百萬 token 輸入 $1、輸出 $5。⟦諮詢秘書整理帳冊時，以前見到特殊格式就硬加欄位導致整本報廢，離線時更把新服務當成免費招待；現在會先驗證改好的版本，確認格式沒壞才替換原本帳冊，斷網時也能查閱隨身底冊如實計價。⟧
body.en: If you regularly enable Token Saver mode for Codex to conserve tokens (text units processed and billed by AI), or often work in offline environments, you can now maintain settings and track spending more reliably. If `~/.codex/config.toml` was written as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, older versions added an extra `[features]` section that prevented Codex from loading; it now checks whether the modified content parses first, leaving the original file untouched if the edit would fail to parse. If downloading the price table failed, GPT-6.1 Terra originally counted as $0; the built-in fallback now includes its pricing, at $1 for input and $5 for output per million tokens. ⟦A secretary organizing account ledgers faced similar challenges: previously, forcing extra columns into an unfamiliar format ruined the entire book, and working offline led to treating new services as complimentary; now the revised version is verified first, replacing the original ledger only after confirming the format remains intact, while a pocket ledger is consulted to price services accurately during network outages.⟧

items.original:
**Turning on Token Saver no longer breaks some Codex configs.** If `~/.codex/config.toml` wrote the features setting as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, usage added a second `[features]` section and Codex then refused to load the file. usage now checks the edited file first and leaves it untouched if the edit would not parse.
**GPT-6.1 Terra is priced while offline.** Codex's new GPT-6.1 Terra model counted as $0 whenever the price table could not be downloaded. The built-in fallback now carries its price, $1 / $5 per million input / output tokens.

title.zh-TW: 面板標題保留英文字尾完整顯示，並移除已下架的 AI 圓桌頁面
title.en: Panel titles fully display English letter descenders, and the retired AI Council page is removed

body.zh-TW: 換上不同主題面板瀏覽專案用量，標題文字不再因為邊框過矮而出現破版截斷。在預設、摺紙、彩繪玻璃、手繪筆記、心電圖和視窗 95 面板裡，「Antigravity」與「Project Usage」等標題中的 g 與 y，字尾以往會被切掉下半截。這是因為裁切長標題的外框比字體還矮，現在外框替字尾留出空間，維持版面位置不變。應用程式也不再夾帶已下架的 AI 圓桌視窗。v0.30.11 下架該功能時漏刪了頁面，由於沒有任何程式會載入它，本版已將其清理移除。⟦挑選展覽相框時，以前邊框尺寸比照片還小導致邊緣文字被壓扁，倉庫角落甚至還留著前年撤展的空展牌；現在相框預留足夠邊界完整襯托字樣，閒置已久的展板也一併清空撤離。⟧
body.en: When switching between themed panels to browse project usage, title text is no longer cut off due to overly short bounding boxes. In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor, and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" previously had the lower halves of descenders on letters g and y cut off. This happened because the frame trimming long titles was shorter than the font; the frame now leaves room for descenders while keeping layout positioning unchanged. The application also no longer bundles the retired AI Council window. When v0.30.11 retired this feature, its page was left behind, and because no program loaded it, this version cleans up and removes it. ⟦Framing artwork for an exhibition works the same way: previously, frames smaller than the photos squashed marginal lettering, and warehouse corners still held empty signboards from displays dismantled two years ago; now frames preserve ample borders to display lettering fully, while long-idle boards are cleared away together.⟧

items.original:
**Panel titles no longer cut off the bottoms of g and y.** In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" lost the tails of their descenders, because the box that trims long titles was shorter than the letters. The box now has room for them; the layout does not move.
**The app no longer bundles the retired AI Council window.** Its page was left behind when the feature was removed in v0.30.11, and nothing loaded it.

entries: **Antigravity countdowns no longer slip later when Google skips a quota group.** When one quota response leaves out a model group, usage keeps showing it for up to 30 minutes. The kept reading was treated as brand new, so its reset countdown moved later by however long ago it was fetched. It now counts down from the original reading.

**The Gemini ⇄ button can always switch back.** With only the Claude / GPT and Argon groups present, switching to Argon left the button stuck there, because the next press asked for Gemini and fell back to Argon again. The button now cycles only through the groups Antigravity reports.

**Argon's compact card shows the right rows after switching groups.** Argon has a weekly limit only, so its compact card hides the 5-hour row. Switching groups on macOS kept the previous group's choice until the next refresh, and the Windows tray never applied it.

**Saved usage history no longer loses days when a report is built during a background save.** Both write `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` and `~/.usage/year_ledger.json`; if they overlapped, the one that finished last could drop what the other had just saved.

title.zh-TW: Google 漏回模型額度時，Antigravity 重置倒數不再延後
title.en: Antigravity countdowns no longer slip later when Google skips a quota group

body.zh-TW: 當你隨時盯著用量面板確認額度何時恢復時，可能會納悶為什麼倒數時間會突然往後跳。當 Google 回傳的額度回應漏掉了某個模型群組，工具會先沿用上次的數字最多 30 分鐘，避免介面突然開天窗。⟦跟看月台上的列車進站看板一樣，以前若有一班列車的連線訊號短暫中斷，看板把剛才留存的舊紀錄誤當成即時動態，進站倒數就跟著往後多跳好一陣子；現在看板懂得對齊最初抓到的時間點，維持原本的節奏持續倒數。⟧過去這筆被沿用的舊數字會被誤當成剛抓到的最新資料，導致重置倒數被無故往後順延，延後的時間正好等於它是多久前抓取的。現在工具會精確對照最初抓到那筆數字的時間點倒數，讓你看到的重置時間始終維持一致。
body.en: When watching the usage popover to check when quota recovers, you might wonder why the countdown time suddenly jumps later. When a quota response returned by Google leaves out a model group, the tool temporarily carries over the last figure for up to 30 minutes to prevent the interface from going blank. ⟦Think of watching a train arrival board on a platform: previously, if a train's connection signal briefly dropped, the board mistook the saved record for live updates, pushing the arrival countdown back by quite a bit; now the board knows to align with the originally fetched timestamp, maintaining its original pace as it continues counting down.⟧ In the past, this carried-over old figure was mistaken for freshly fetched data, causing the reset countdown to slip later for no reason by however long ago it was retrieved. Now the tool counts down precisely against the timestamp when that figure was originally fetched, keeping the reset time you see completely consistent.

items.original: **Antigravity countdowns no longer slip later when Google skips a quota group.** When one quota response leaves out a model group, usage keeps showing it for up to 30 minutes. The kept reading was treated as brand new, so its reset countdown moved later by however long ago it was fetched. It now counts down from the original reading.

title.zh-TW: 切至 Argon 群組不再卡死按鈕，精簡卡片同步隱藏五小時列
title.en: Switching to the Argon group no longer leaves the button stuck, and compact cards hide the 5-hour row

body.zh-TW: 在切換不同模型群組時，如果目前清單只剩 Claude / GPT 與 Argon 兩組，以前只要按「Gemini ⇄」切換到 Argon，按鈕就會卡在該處動彈不得。因為下一次點擊會嘗試尋找 Gemini，找不到時又退回備援的 Argon。現在按鈕只會在 Antigravity 實際回報的群組之間正常循環切換。⟦拿遙控器切換輸入訊號時，以前按鍵不管接了幾台裝置都硬要跳回預設頻道，找不到便退回備援訊號卡死，螢幕面板還留著前一台機器的多餘列；現在按鍵只在實際連接的設備間輪流切換，顯示面板也會隨之套用對應排版。⟧針對只有每週額度而沒有 5 小時額度的 Argon，其精簡卡片本該藏起 5 小時那列。過去在 macOS 切換群組時會沿用上一組設定，直到下次刷新才更新，Windows 系統匣更是從未套用隱藏設定；現在切換群組後，精簡卡片會立即更新並顯示正確的列。
body.en: When switching between model groups, if only the Claude / GPT and Argon groups are currently listed, previously clicking "Gemini ⇄" to switch to Argon left the button stuck there. Because the next click would look for Gemini, and when it could not be found, fall back to Argon again. Now the button cycles normally only through the groups Antigravity actually reports. ⟦When using a remote control to switch input signals, the button previously insisted on jumping back to a default channel regardless of how many devices were connected, falling back to a fallback signal and getting stuck if it could not find it, while the screen panel kept leftover rows from the previous machine; now the button cycles only among actually connected devices, and the display panel adapts its layout accordingly.⟧ For Argon, which has a weekly limit only and no 5-hour limit, its compact card is supposed to hide the 5-hour row. In the past, switching groups on macOS kept the previous group's settings until the next refresh, while the Windows tray never applied the hide setting at all; now, after switching groups, the compact card updates immediately and displays the correct rows.

items.original:
**The Gemini ⇄ button can always switch back.** With only the Claude / GPT and Argon groups present, switching to Argon left the button stuck there, because the next press asked for Gemini and fell back to Argon again. The button now cycles only through the groups Antigravity reports.
**Argon's compact card shows the right rows after switching groups.** Argon has a weekly limit only, so its compact card hides the 5-hour row. Switching groups on macOS kept the previous group's choice until the next refresh, and the Windows tray never applied it.

title.zh-TW: 背景存檔遇上產出報表時，用量歷史不會再漏失天數
title.en: Saved usage history no longer loses days when a report is built during a background save

body.zh-TW: 當你一邊讓工具在背景自動記錄用量，一邊手動產出統計報表時，可能會發現存下來的歷史紀錄莫名少了好幾天。這是因為背景儲存歷史與產生報表這兩項動作，都會同時寫入 `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` 與 `~/.usage/year_ledger.json` 這兩個檔案。⟦碰上兩名值班人員同時更新同一份紙本巡邏紀錄時，以前若兩人各自拿複印本填寫再夾回板子，後放回的那份就會把前一人剛補上的簽章整頁覆蓋。⟧過去如果兩邊的操作時間重疊，後寫完的一方就會直接蓋過前一邊剛存好的內容，導致先完成的幾天資料憑空消失。現在產生報表與背景儲存重疊時，不會再因此遺失剛存好的歷史紀錄。
body.en: While letting the tool automatically record usage in the background and manually generating a statistical report, you might find that saved history mysteriously lost several days. This is because both background history saves and report generation write to the two files `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` and `~/.usage/year_ledger.json` at the same time. ⟦Consider two duty officers updating the same paper patrol log: previously, if each filled out a separate photocopy and clipped it back onto the board, whichever copy was returned last would overwrite the entire page along with the other person's newly added signatures.⟧ In the past, if the two operations overlapped in time, whichever finished writing last would directly overwrite what the other side had just saved, causing several days of previously completed data to vanish. Now, when report generation overlaps with a background save, freshly saved history will no longer be lost.

items.original: **Saved usage history no longer loses days when a report is built during a background save.** Both write `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` and `~/.usage/year_ledger.json`; if they overlapped, the one that finished last could drop what the other had just saved.

entries: **The usage report shows where each dispatch quota went.** The dispatch ledger's seven-column table is now "Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days)": one block per quota, for Codex and each Antigravity model group, with how much of it is used this week, the conversations whose dispatched work used it (top five, then "N more"), and the rest as "Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found)". Antigravity groups each have their own weekly quota and are no longer added together; the old table could total more than 100%. When all of Codex's usage came before its reset, the block says so in one line.

**The Muse card records a used-up weekly allowance as the weekly limit.** Muse sends the same "Subscription quota exhausted" error for both limits, and v0.34.5 always recorded it as the 5-hour window. A used-up week showed "Session 100%, resets in 3 days" while the weekly row kept an old reading. A reset more than 5 hours away now marks the weekly row as 100% with that reset time.
**Wrapped captions say "over the past year".** The data covers a rolling 53 weeks, not the calendar year.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表按派工額度分塊顯示，清楚列出對話消耗明細
title.en: Usage report splits dispatch quotas into separate blocks with per-conversation details

body.zh-TW: 當你頻繁指派 AI 處理各類任務時，常常需要確認不同模型的配額到底耗費在哪些對話上。派工帳本原本採用七欄表格，現在改為「派工額度花在哪（最近 7 天）」，替 Codex 與每個 Antigravity 模型群組各自獨立分塊。⟦跟翻閱專案的請款帳本一樣，以前所有項目的開銷全擠在一張大表格裡，既難以對照個別上限，加總甚至還會莫名破表；現在各預算項目獨立成頁，清楚列出金額最高的前幾筆花費，對帳時便能逐筆核實。⟧每個區塊都會標出本週已用額度，並列出消耗最多的前五個派工對話，其餘對話寫成「另外 N 段」，剩下的用量歸入「其他（你直接用的，或沒對到派工紀錄）」。Antigravity 每個群組各自計算週額度，不再合併相加，避免舊表格加總超過 100% 的情形；若 Codex 用量全在額度重置前發生，該區塊也會以一句話說明。
body.en: When you frequently assign AI different tasks, you often need to check which conversations have used up each model’s quota. The dispatch ledger’s seven-column table has now been replaced with “Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days),” with separate blocks for Codex and each Antigravity model group. ⟦It works like reviewing a project’s expense ledger: previously, every item’s spending was crammed into one large table, making it hard to check against individual limits, and the totals could even inexplicably exceed the budget. Now each budget category has its own page listing the largest expenses, so you can verify them individually when reconciling the accounts.⟧ Each block shows the quota used this week and lists the top five conversations whose dispatched work used it. Remaining conversations appear as “N more,” and the remaining usage goes under “Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found).” Each Antigravity group’s weekly quota is calculated separately instead of being added together, preventing the old table’s totals from exceeding 100%. If all Codex usage occurred before the quota reset, its block also explains that in a sentence.

items.original: **The usage report shows where each dispatch quota went.** The dispatch ledger's seven-column table is now "Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days)": one block per quota, for Codex and each Antigravity model group, with how much of it is used this week, the conversations whose dispatched work used it (top five, then "N more"), and the rest as "Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found)". Antigravity groups each have their own weekly quota and are no longer added together; the old table could total more than 100%. When all of Codex's usage came before its reset, the block says so in one line.

title.zh-TW: Muse 週額度用盡正確歸屬，卡片依重置時間標記上限
title.en: Muse weekly quota exhaustion is correctly identified, with cards marking limits by reset time

body.zh-TW: 長時間使用 Muse 容易撞上用量限制，此時介面回報哪種額度見底，決定了它告訴你要等多久。Muse 的五小時額度與週額度用完時，都會回傳相同的「Subscription quota exhausted」（訂閱額度已耗盡）錯誤訊息。⟦像在手機門市查詢多個方案用量，以前不管哪種配額見底，簡訊都只通報短週期方案已滿，明明是週方案用盡卻標註三天後重置；現在若重置間隔拉長，介面便會精準指出真正用滿的是長週期配額，並如實標上恢復時間。⟧舊版 v0.34.5 一律將該錯誤判定為五小時額度耗盡，導致週額度用完時，卡片顯示「工作階段 100%、3 天後重置」，而週額度那列仍停在舊數字。現在只要重置時間超過 5 小時，卡片就會把週額度記錄為 100%，並帶上正確的重置時間。
body.en: Extended use of Muse can hit usage limits, and which quota the interface reports as exhausted determines how long it tells you to wait. Muse returns the same “Subscription quota exhausted” error message whether its five-hour or weekly quota runs out. ⟦Imagine checking usage across several plans at a mobile phone store. Previously, whichever quota ran out, the text message only reported that the short-cycle plan was full. Even when the weekly plan was exhausted, it showed a reset in three days. Now, if the reset interval is longer, the interface accurately identifies the longer-cycle quota as the one that is full and shows its actual recovery time.⟧ The old v0.34.5 always treated this error as five-hour quota exhaustion. When the weekly quota ran out, the card therefore showed “Session 100%, resets in 3 days,” while the weekly quota row still displayed its previous value. Now, whenever the reset is more than 5 hours away, the card records the weekly quota as 100% and includes the correct reset time.

items.original: **The Muse card records a used-up weekly allowance as the weekly limit.** Muse sends the same "Subscription quota exhausted" error for both limits, and v0.34.5 always recorded it as the 5-hour window. A used-up week showed "Session 100%, resets in 3 days" while the weekly row kept an old reading. A reset more than 5 hours away now marks the weekly row as 100% with that reset time.

title.zh-TW: Wrapped 說明文字改為近一年，反映滾動 53 週數據
title.en: Wrapped description now says “over the past year” to reflect rolling 53-week data

body.zh-TW: 翻閱 Wrapped 的個人 AI 用量摘要時，介面標註的時間範圍會直接影響你對數據的理解。Wrapped 實際統計最近連續 53 週，說明文字現在寫成「近一年」，讓你知道這份回顧不是從今年一月一日起算。⟦好比查看運動手環的年累積步數，若沒看清楚統計期間，容易以為紀錄只從一月一日起算；標記成近一年，就能明白數據呈現的是最近一整年的連續走勢。⟧
body.en: When reviewing your personal AI usage summary in Wrapped, the time range shown in the interface directly affects how you interpret the data. Wrapped actually covers the most recent 53 consecutive weeks. Its description now says “over the past year,” making it clear that the review does not start on January 1 of the current year. ⟦Think of checking the yearly step total on a fitness tracker. If you overlook the reporting period, you might assume the record starts on January 1. Labeling it “over the past year” makes it clear that the data shows a continuous trend across the most recent full year.⟧

items.original: **Wrapped captions say "over the past year".** The data covers a rolling 53 weeks, not the calendar year.

entries: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.

title.zh-TW: Muse 額度用完即使未給數字，卡片也會標示 5 小時已用滿
title.en: Cards mark the 5-hour quota as full even when Muse provides no numbers upon exhaustion

body.zh-TW: 當你連續使用 Muse 處理工作時，一旦額度耗盡，往往會想確認何時才能繼續。以往 5 小時額度一用完，Muse 通常會直接拒絕額度查詢，只拋出「Subscription quota exhausted」錯誤訊息並告知重置時間，導致卡片拿不到具體數字。⟦跟運動場地的租借機一樣，以前名額一被搶光，票機只印出額滿通知與下一場時間，看板卻因抓不到剩餘數值而沒能更新；現在螢幕會直接標示目前時段已全滿，並貼上下次開放進場的時刻。⟧現在卡片遇到這種狀況，會主動把 5 小時額度顯示為 100%，並附上該重置時間。因為這項錯誤回報裡沒有週額度數字，所以卡片上的週額度百分比會沿用上次的讀數，卡片也保留「上次查詢」的時間提示，讓你在等待額度恢復時依然能掌握先前的用量狀態。
body.en: When you use Muse continuously for work, you often want to confirm when you can resume once your quota runs out. Previously, as soon as the 5-hour quota was exhausted, Muse would typically reject quota queries outright, only throwing a "Subscription quota exhausted" error message alongside the reset time, leaving the card without concrete numbers. ⟦Much like a sports venue reservation kiosk, where the ticket machine previously printed only a full notice and the next session time once slots filled up, leaving the display unupdated because it could not fetch the remaining count, the screen now directly marks the current slot as completely full and displays the time for the next admission.⟧ Now when encountering this situation, the card proactively displays the 5-hour quota at 100% and attaches that reset time. Because this error response contains no weekly quota figures, the weekly quota percentage on the card retains its previous reading, and the card also preserves its "last checked" badge, allowing you to keep track of prior usage status while waiting for the quota to recover.

entries: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.

title.zh-TW: Muse 的 5 小時額度用完後持續更新，用量卡片顯示已用滿
title.en: Muse continues updating after 5-hour quota is exhausted, with usage card showing full

body.zh-TW: 平時頻繁使用 Muse 協作時，如果額度見底，你可能會打開 `usage` 查看剩餘狀況與重置時間。⟦跟看停車場入口的剩餘車位看板一樣，以前場內車輛停滿甚至超額借停時，計數器因為讀到破表數字而停止刷新，螢幕凍結在用滿前一刻並掛著過期提示；現在就算車位全滿，看板也會持續更新並清楚顯示客滿。⟧Muse 在 5 小時額度耗盡時，回報的使用率常會超過 100%（例如 104%）。以前 `usage` 會直接把這種大於 100% 的讀數丟掉。這導致卡片一直停留在低於 100% 的最後一次讀數，並掛著過期標籤（stale-age badge，標示資料多久未更新的標籤），直到 5 小時週期重置。現在卡片在 5 小時額度用完後仍會持續刷新，並清楚標示為已用滿，方便你隨時掌握最新狀態。
body.en: When frequently collaborating with Muse, if your quota runs low, you might open `usage` to check the remaining status and reset time. ⟦Think of the vacancy board at a parking lot entrance. Previously, when the lot was full or even overfilled with parked cars, the counter stopped updating because it read an off-the-charts number, freezing the screen right before full capacity with an expired notice. Now, even when all spaces are full, the board continues to update and clearly displays that the lot is full.⟧ Muse exhausts its 5-hour quota, the reported usage often exceeds 100% (such as 104%). Previously, `usage` would directly discard readings greater than 100%. This caused the card to remain stuck at the last reading below 100% with a stale-age badge (a label indicating how long data has not been updated) until the 5-hour cycle reset. Now, the card continues to refresh after the 5-hour quota is exhausted and clearly indicates that it is full, making it easy for you to track the latest status at any time.

items.original: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.

entries: **Windows: the taskbar label stops scanning taskbar buttons while the screen is locked.** The scan runs every 2 seconds through UI Automation and is the main suspect in an unexplained crash that happened while Windows was locked (refs #202). Nothing changes while unlocked. This is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and no longer clutters your resume list.** The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session; the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`. Each ping used to load about 20k input tokens and leave an "ok" conversation in `claude --resume` and `codex resume`.

title.zh-TW: Windows 鎖定螢幕時，工作列標籤暫停掃描
title.en: On Windows, the taskbar label stops scanning while the screen is locked

body.zh-TW: 有 Windows 使用者回報，電腦鎖定期間 `usage` 曾莫名當掉，原因還沒查清楚（refs #202）。工作列上的額度標籤每 2 秒會透過 UI Automation 掃描一次工作列按鈕，好決定自己擺哪裡，這個掃描是頭號嫌疑。現在螢幕鎖定時就不掃，解鎖後一切照舊。⟦像社區警衛晚上關店後就不再每兩分鐘巡一次空蕩蕩的商店街，以前整夜照巡、偶爾自己絆倒，現在鎖門就休息。⟧官方說得很清楚：這是降低風險的措施，不是確認的修復，如果之後還有當機，請繼續回報。
body.en: Some Windows users reported `usage` crashing for no clear reason while the computer was locked, and the cause is still unknown (refs #202). The quota label on the taskbar scans the taskbar buttons every 2 seconds through UI Automation to decide where to sit, and that scan is the main suspect. It now stops scanning while the screen is locked, and nothing changes while the screen is in use. ⟦A night guard used to patrol the empty shopping street every two minutes all night and occasionally trip; now the patrol pauses once the shutters are down.⟧ The changelog is explicit that this is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix, so keep reporting any further crashes.

items.original: **Windows: the taskbar label stops scanning taskbar buttons while the screen is locked.** The scan runs every 2 seconds through UI Automation and is the main suspect in an unexplained crash that happened while Windows was locked (refs #202). Nothing changes while unlocked. This is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix.

title.zh-TW: 自動啟動 5 小時計時的背景訊息變輕，也不再塞滿接續清單
title.en: Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and stops cluttering your resume list

body.zh-TW: 想接續昨天的對話，打開 `claude --resume` 或 `codex resume` 卻看到一整排只寫著「ok」的紀錄，要翻半天才找到真正的那筆。那些都是「自動啟動 5 小時計時」在背景送出的小訊息留下的，而且每則還會載入約 2 萬 input token（AI 計算用量的單位）。⟦像每天只是去郵局蓋個戳，以前卻得扛整箱文件排隊，還在登記簿留一筆；現在空手去、蓋完就走。⟧現在 Claude 那則不再載入工具和 MCP 伺服器，也不存成工作階段；Codex 那則改用 `--ephemeral` 執行，同樣不留紀錄。
body.en: You want to pick up yesterday's conversation, open `claude --resume` or `codex resume`, and find a long row of entries that just say "ok" before the real one. Those came from the small background pings sent by Auto-start 5-hour Session, and each ping also loaded about 20k input tokens (the unit AI usage is measured in). ⟦It was like going to the post office just for a stamp while hauling a whole box of documents and signing the logbook each time; now you go empty-handed and leave once it is stamped.⟧ The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session, and the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`, leaving no record either.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and no longer clutters your resume list.** The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session; the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`. Each ping used to load about 20k input tokens and leave an "ok" conversation in `claude --resume` and `codex resume`.

entries: **The Windows build ships Pillow 13.0.0.** Pillow 12.3.0, which draws the Windows tray icon and taskbar quota label, had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, but installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI now requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later as well.

**The Gemini ⇄ button hides again when Antigravity has only one quota group.** v0.34.1 restyled it in the default panel and the new style overrode its hidden state, so it showed a button that did nothing.
**Heart Monitor's English footer buttons keep their text inside.** "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit; button labels now wrap.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版改用 Pillow 13.0.0，補上圖片解碼漏洞
title.en: The Windows build moves to Pillow 13.0.0 to close image-decoder vulnerabilities

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上用 `usage` 的人，工作列那個額度數字和系統匣圖示，背後是靠 Pillow（Python 的繪圖套件）畫出來的。原本用的 Pillow 12.3.0，圖片解碼部分有 9 個已知漏洞，其中 1 個屬嚴重等級。`usage` 只畫自己的圖示，從不打開外來的圖片，所以這些漏洞原本就碰不太到它。⟦就像家裡的門鎖被通報有瑕疵，雖然你從不把鑰匙借人，還是順手換了新鎖。⟧現在 Windows 版改用 Pillow 13.0.0；從 PyPI 安裝 `usage-cli[windows]` 時，也會要求 Pillow 13.0.0 以上，裝的時候會一起升級。
body.en: If you run `usage` on Windows, the quota number on the taskbar and the tray icon are drawn by Pillow (a Python drawing library). The Pillow 12.3.0 it used had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, so these flaws were hard to reach anyway. ⟦Think of a lock maker announcing a defect: even if you never lend out your key, you swap in the new lock anyway.⟧ The Windows build now ships Pillow 13.0.0, and installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later, so it upgrades along the way.

items.original: **The Windows build ships Pillow 13.0.0.** Pillow 12.3.0, which draws the Windows tray icon and taskbar quota label, had nine known vulnerabilities in its image decoders, one of them critical. `usage` only draws its own icons and never opens images from elsewhere, but installing `usage-cli[windows]` from PyPI now requires Pillow 13.0.0 or later as well.

title.zh-TW: 沒反應的「Gemini ⇄」按鈕又藏起來了，心電圖面板英文按鈕不再爆字
title.en: The dead "Gemini ⇄" button hides again, and Heart Monitor's English buttons fit their text

body.zh-TW: 畫面上出現一顆按了沒反應的按鈕，很容易讓人以為程式壞了。「Gemini ⇄」按鈕本來只在 Antigravity 有兩組以上額度時才出現，但 v0.34.1 在預設面板替它換了新樣式，新樣式蓋掉了隱藏效果。⟦好比店家換了新招牌，卻忘了把「本日公休」的牌子掛回去，客人推門才發現沒人；現在牌子掛好了，只有一組額度時按鈕會照舊藏起來。⟧心電圖佈景的英文版也有擠字問題：底部「Set Up Status Line」跟 Refresh、Quit 排在同一列放不下，字跑出按鈕外，現在按鈕文字會自動換行。
body.en: A button that does nothing when pressed makes it easy to think the app is broken. The "Gemini ⇄" button is meant to appear only when Antigravity has more than one quota group, but v0.34.1 gave it a new style in the default panel and that style overrode its hidden state. ⟦A shop put up a new sign and forgot to hang the "closed today" notice back up, so customers pushed the door and found nobody; the notice is back, and with only one quota group the button hides as before.⟧ Heart Monitor's English footer was cramped too: "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit and spilled outside its button, and button labels now wrap.

items.original:
**The Gemini ⇄ button hides again when Antigravity has only one quota group.** v0.34.1 restyled it in the default panel and the new style overrode its hidden state, so it showed a button that did nothing.
**Heart Monitor's English footer buttons keep their text inside.** "Set Up Status Line" did not fit next to Refresh and Quit; button labels now wrap.
